You'll work in them daily, and you're expected to know them well enough to say when they're getting it wrong. What You’ll Do Partner acquisition and recruitment. Recruit and grow high-value IBs, affiliates, fintech partners, payment providers, and strategic alliances across your assigned MENA markets — including the harder-to-close accounts junior executives tend to hand off. Portfolio activation and performance. Own the full lifecycle for a larger, more complex portfolio, from onboarding through to revenue performance. Spot underperforming accounts before the numbers make it obvious, and build the plan to fix them. Commercial deal structuring. Negotiate commission structures, volume targets, and support agreements with more latitude on terms than an entry-level role carries. Know the unit economics well enough to defend a deal to your own leadership, not just to the partner. AI-enabled operational contribution. Work inside AI-enabled onboarding and lifecycle systems, and flag workflow gaps to product and engineering with enough specificity that they can actually act on it. Mentorship within the team. Help onboard and troubleshoot for newer Business Development Executives, sharing what you've learned about reading partners and structuring deals that hold up. Industry representation. Represent Deriv at conferences and partner events — including iFX Expo, Finance Magnates, Forex Expo Dubai, and regional growth events — where you're expected to open doors, not just attend. Who You Are You've spent a couple of years in business development, partnerships, or sales within online trading, FX/CFD, fintech, or a comparably performance-driven digital ecosystem, and you can point to deals you actually closed. You know how IB and affiliate ecosystems operate well enough to spot a bad deal structure before it costs anyone money. You don't just open conversations — you close them, and you can explain why a deal was structured the way it was without leaning on a script. You're the person a newer teammate asks when a partner conversation stalls, and you're comfortable being that resource without a formal management title. You use AI tools daily in your own workflow, and when something in the system doesn't fit how partners actually behave, you say so specifically instead of working around it quietly. Fluency in English and Arabic is required, given the role's focus on MENA. Additional languages — French, Spanish, or Portuguese — are an advantage if your remit extends further. You hold a relevant degree in business, economics, finance, or equivalent, and have close to five years of relevant experience. The Honest Reality This is demanding work. You'll be handed the accounts junior executives couldn't close, and some of them won't close for you either. You'll make commercial calls with incomplete information and live with how they play out — and you'll be expected to help train the person next to you while you're still building out your own portfolio. What you'll get in return: real weight in the region's numbers, credibility with operators who've been doing this longer than you have, and more say in deal terms than an entry-level role would ever give you. If you want a role where the hard accounts get handed to someone more senior, this isn't it. If you want to be the person those accounts get handed to, it might be.

review_candidates.title: Sales Specialist in Amsterdam
review_candidates.description: Wat ga je doen? Als Sales Specialist werk je dagelijks mee aan het organiseren van privévaarten en groepsarrangementen op onze sloepen en salonboten in Amsterdam. Denk aan bedrijfsuitjes, verjaardagen, vrijgezellenfeesten, borrels en zelfs bruiloften op het water. Jij zorgt ervoor dat deze events van begin tot eind goed geregeld zijn: van het eerste klantcontact en het opstellen van de offerte tot de volledige uitvoering op de dag zelf. Jouw verantwoordelijkheden Coördineren van privévaarten en groepsboekingen van A tot Z; Alle benodigdheden voor een rondvaart afstemmen met de juiste afdelingen, zoals haven, schippers, hosts en cateraars; Meedenken met klanten en adviseren over verschillende soorten events en arrangementen; Opstellen van offertes en ondersteunen bij de facturatie; Onderhouden van contact met verschillende leveranciers; Beantwoorden van inkomende telefoontjes en zorgen voor een positieve en professionele klantervaring; Informeren van klanten over onze producten, arrangementen en mogelijkheden; Signaleren van commerciële kansen; Verzamelen van feedback na afloop van events om de gastbeleving continu te verbeteren, bijvoorbeeld via enquêtes of telefonisch contact. Praktisch Locatie: Kantoor in hartje Amsterdam Salaris: Tussen de €2.700 - €2.900 per maand op basis van 40 uur + jaarlijkse bonus Startdatum: In overleg Dit bieden wij 25 vakantiedagen per jaar en de mogelijkheid om 10 extra vakantiedagen bij te kopen; Bedrijfsfitness via Urban Sports; Pensioenopbouw via Brand New Day; Een gezellige werksfeer en een verzorgde lunch op ons kantoor in hartje Amsterdam; 25% personeelskorting op rondvaarten en andere activiteiten binnen Flagship Holding; Mogelijkheid om je vaarbewijs te halen; Legendarische bedrijfsfeesten en borrels; Werken bij een award-winnend bedrijf (Tripadvisor #1 Top Overall Experience in the World) . Functievereisten Minimaal 1 jaar relevante werkervaring in sales, verkoop of een vergelijkbare commerciële functie; Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk; Een assertieve en flexibele houding en geen 9-tot-5-mentaliteit; Klantvriendelijkheid staat voorop; Oog voor detail en een proactieve werkhouding; Talent voor upselling en sterke commerciële vaardigheden; Heldere en overtuigende communicatieve vaardigheden. Over Flagship Flagship Amsterdam is een jonge en snelgroeiende rederij in het hart van Amsterdam. Wat in 2017 begon met drie boten, is inmiddels uitgegroeid tot een vloot van meer dan 70 boten, en we groeien nog steeds elke dag verder! Jaarlijks verwelkomen we gasten uit meer dan 55 verschillende landen, en we varen het hele jaar door. Dit doen we met een gedreven en ambitieus team van meer dan 800 (seizoensgebonden) medewerkers. Maar Flagship is meer dan alleen rondvaarten. Vanuit dezelfde energie bouwen we aan verschillende concepten die allemaal draaien om beleving, gastvrijheid en de stad Amsterdam. Zo ontdek je de stad op de fiets met Flagship Bike Tours, proef je de sfeer bij Flagship Waffle Experience Amsterdam, en werken we bij Shipyard aan unieke events en creatieve projecten op en rond het water. Daarnaast hebben we labels zoals Voyage Amsterdam, Captain Jack en Aemstelland, elk met hun eigen stijl en doelgroep. Samen vormen ze één organisatie, maar met verschillende manieren om mensen de stad te laten ervaren.

review_candidates.title: Sales Coordinator
review_candidates.description: ( 20704 ) At One&Only, we exist to create joy for our guests through anticipation, creativity, precision, empathy and warmth. We tailor every aspect of our guests’ stay to bring their dreams and desires to life. With an atmosphere that’s chic but wonderfully unstuffy™, and a team who are meticulous but warm, we seek to exceed our guests’ expectations at every possible turn. Sparkling in warm Indian Ocean, on a private peninsula wrapped in ribbons of sand, One&Only Le Saint Géran is a vibrant tropical playground where the marvels of Mauritius are revealed in ultimate style. With abundant knowledge and generosity, we anticipate our guest’s every need and surpass expectations. Whether we are designing the perfect family day out or arranging a romantic private dinner, we approach everything with imagination to spark a sense of playfulness, discovery and adventure. This is not simply our job, it’s our passion. About This Role The Sales Coordinator provides administrative and operational support to the Sales team to ensure smooth handling of client inquiries, group bookings, contracts, events, and sales activities. The role involves coordinating with internal departments, maintaining client records, preparing proposals and reports, and assisting in achieving the hotel's revenue and occupancy targets while delivering exceptional guest service. Key Responsibilities Sales Administration Provide administrative support to the Sales and Marketing team. Prepare and distribute proposals, contracts, and banquet event orders (BEOs). Maintain accurate client databases and sales records. Process and track correspondence, contracts, and agreements. Prepare weekly and monthly sales reports. Client Relationship Management Respond to client inquiries in a timely and professional manner. Coordinate site inspections and hotel tours for potential clients. Maintain regular communication with corporate, travel trade, and group clients. Assist in building strong relationships with existing and prospective customers. Coordination & Operations Liaise with Front Office, Reservations, Food & Beverage, Events, and other departments to ensure guest requirements are met. Coordinate group bookings, conferences, meetings, and special events. Ensure all booking details and client requests are accurately communicated to operational teams. Follow up on event logistics and guest satisfaction. Revenue & Business Support Assist the Sales team in achieving sales targets and revenue goals. Monitor booking activity and update sales pipelines. Support promotional campaigns, trade shows, and marketing initiatives. Conduct market research and competitor analysis when required. Compliance & Standards Ensure compliance with hotel policies, procedures, and brand standards. Maintain confidentiality of client information and business data. Adhere to health, safety, and security requirements. About You Diploma or Degree in Hospitality Management, Business Administration, Sales, Marketing, or a related field. Previous experience in hospitality sales, reservations, events, or administrative support is preferred. Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook). Familiarity with hotel PMS and CRM systems is advantageous. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Strong organizational and multitasking abilities. Attention to detail and accuracy. Customer-focused approach. Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines. Strong problem-solving and coordination skills. Professional presentation and telephone etiquette. Our brand is expanding faster than ever before. We are investing in the growth of our company, and that means we are committed to investing in you. Join a team that is open-hearted, intuitive, generous, and spontaneous in spirit. We believe in making our guests happy beyond anything they have ever imagined. We wow them at every turn and create memories that will last a lifetime. You will be at the heart of this vision, to constantly innovate to deliver Amazing Experiences and Everlasting Memories.
